messages:
Anika (AE): FYI opening thread for Evergreen Health POC — they want multivariant support (generation + embeddings) and need a short checklist on compatibility and pricing.
Leo (Solutions Eng): @Anika got it. Do we know which model family they want to test?
Anika (AE): Customer mentioned 'open-13b' custom fork + a distilled 7b variant for cheaper throughput. Also asked about a quantized variant we offer.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Ok. Main compatibility checks: tokenizer parity, kv-cache layout for prefix caching, and whether our quant path supports the cust fork's fused kernels.
Sam (SRE): For infra, two notes: 1) quantized 7b can run on T4-sized pools; 13b needs A10/A100 for reasonable latency. 2) If they want dedicated capacity we should size for peak QPS (they estimated ~25 rps, 200 tokens avg).
Maria (Security): They also dropped a security questionnaire. Top blockers: KMS integration, data residency, and audit logs. We need to confirm KMS flows for Private and Dedicated.
Priya (Product): Also add rollout policy expectations — they want canary + quick rollback and model pinning.
Anika (AE): They asked about pricing for mixed workload (generation 60%, embeddings 40%) and if we can do a committed monthly discount for Dedicated.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Pricing rough calc: hosted per-token for gen + embeddings; for Dedicated we can provide reserved pool pricing. I'll prepare a sample: commit for 100M tokens/mo mapped to a 3 GPU pool.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Quick technical checklist I can share with them:
```
- Model artifacts: HF tarball + tokenizer files (vocab.json, merges/special_tokens)
- Preferred alias: evergreen-open-13b-v1 (must match served model spec)
- Provide sample prompts (max seq len) and perf target (p95 latency)
- Indicate if KV cache warmup allowed for canary
```
Anika (AE): Nice. Can you confirm whether the quantized variant naming breaks our variant resolver? last time we had to add a mapping.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Our catalog resolver expects canonical arch + quant tag. We'll accept alias like `evergreen-13b:q8_0` but need the mapping file in the onboarding payload. I can draft the mapping template.
Sam (SRE): Ops note: if they want prefix caching across variants we need to enable shared KV namespace and ensure compatible KV footprint. That requires a small migration if the model variants have different kv-key shapes.
Maria (Security): For KMS: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys (via KMS) for secrets and model encryption at rest. Private (VPC) supports bring-your-own-key but we need a signed ATO doc. I'll send the checklist for the questionnaire.
Anika (AE): Timeline ask from customer: start POC next Monday, 2-week sprint. Realistic?
Leo (Solutions Eng): Tight. Assuming we get artifacts by EOD Thu, we can onboard to Hosted sandbox in ~48hrs. Dedicated sizing/provisioning adds ~5 business days.
Priya (Product): We should offer a hybrid: initial bake on Hosted sandbox to validate model quality + a parallel Dedicated reservation request to cut provisioning time.
Anika (AE): Sounds good. I'll propose that. Also they asked about eval regression monitoring — can Redwood run evals on deploy and alert on quality drift?
Leo (Solutions Eng): Yes, Redwood Optimize can run eval suites during rollout and trigger rollback on NLL/accuracy regressions vs baseline. We'll need their eval set.
Anika (AE): Great. Action items: 1) @Leo draft variant mapping + technical checklist (ETA Fri EOD) 2) @Maria send security questionnaire answers + KMS doc (ETA Thu) 3) @Sam give Dedicated sizing note and rough lead times (ETA Thu) 4) @Priya prepare POC approach blurb for customer (ETA Fri).
Sam (SRE): Note: I'll also include sample autoscale policy tuned for mixed gen/embed workload (burst to 5 GPUs for 2-3 mins).
Maria (Security): And I'll flag the data residency options (EU region) — Evergreen wants EU-only processing for PHI-adjacent data. Private deployment recommended if they insist.
Anika (AE): I'll draft the customer email after I get the artifacts. Thanks team :thanks:
Leo (Solutions Eng): I'll attach the mapping template and a sample `models.json` snippet in the reply thread once ready.
Anika (AE): Perfect. Closing loop: I'll update calendar invite for onboarding kickoff on Monday and add the POC success criteria (latency target, token cost, quality thresholds).
Priya (Product): One more ask from sales: include an option for a short 2-week cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted so procurement can compare.
Anika (AE): Noted. I'll include both in the proposal.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet I'll send in follow-up for their ops team:
```json
{
  "alias": "evergreen-open-13b-v1",
  "variants": ["evergreen-13b:q8_0","evergreen-7b:fp16"],
  "kv_compat": true
}
```
Anika (AE): Thanks — thread looks actionable. I'll ping if anything urgent comes up before Thursday.
